dynamic_rules.patients_list_reports.r01.d01: office_scope on the 11 reports of this category that have OFFICE/GROUP (all except Patient's Notes, which has no office parameter: scope.office_mode = none, patient visibility via assert_patient_visible): the mode radio decides the value key. Mode office -> the picker lists offices (lookup:offices) and writes office_ids (list, token working_office (default), my_offices or all). Mode office_group -> the picker lists office groups (lookup:office_groups) and writes office_group_id or office_group_ids, default all. A tenant without office groups: mode office_group offers only all, which resolves to every office the caller may read (legacy: a group run covers all offices of the account), never wider than the caller's office rights (filter_card 6.1). Switching the mode resets the selection to that mode's default. Exactly one value key is sent.

dynamic_rules.patients_list_reports.r06.d01: report_by == last_visit: visible = patient_status, office_scope, provider_basis (radio Preferred Provider / Treating Provider), preferred_provider_ids (the PREFERRED PROVIDER picker, filtering the provider chosen by provider_basis), last_visit_date (last_visit_date_from / _to / _preset), include_patient_type_codes, exclude_patient_type_codes, include_patients_with_no_last_visit. Hidden: provider_ids and specialty_codes (visible_when report_by != last_visit, 04 shared rule); their values are replaced by the disabled_value all before hashing, so a value chosen in another mode never filters a Last Visit run.
dynamic_rules.patients_list_reports.r06.d02: report_by != last_visit (attached_to_provider is the default; the other 11 modes were not captured and keep this panel until read on the live tool): visible = patient_status, office_scope, provider_ids, include_patient_type_codes, exclude_patient_type_codes, specialty_codes. Hidden (visible_when report_by == last_visit): provider_basis, preferred_provider_ids, last_visit_date, include_patients_with_no_last_visit; their disabled values (preferred_provider, all, no range, false) add no predicate.

dynamic_rules.patients_list_reports.r09.d01: report_by == send_statement_status: send_statement_status becomes visible and required (required_when report_by == send_statement_status); date_range is hidden (visible_when report_by != send_statement_status, 04 shared rule) and no created-date predicate is applied; exclude_resp_party_type_codes and include_inactive_accounts stay visible. In every other mode send_statement_status is hidden and adds no predicate. report_by == balance_aged_over_x_days additionally shows aged_balance (aged_balance_from / _to, default 1.00 / 999999.99) and aging_days (04 shared vendor-doc parameters; no control of our capture, specified in the report section).

patients_list_reports.r02.s05.c01.notes: Provider role on this report: attached provider (scope.provider_attribution = attached, NEW role: coalesce(rpt_patient_dim.preferred_provider_id, rpt_patient_activity.last_visit_provider_id); owner 04 section 3 provider-role table and 03 section 5.2) - the fallback serves migrated patients, who carry no preferred provider; inferred from the research (old Active Patient List had the same Provider box). Generic key provider_ids kept because the legacy label is plain PROVIDER. ALL = no restriction; patients with neither provider match only under all. Never scoped by providers.office_id.

patients_list_reports.r04.s05.c01.notes: Provider role on this report: provider of the visit (rpt_provider_visits.provider_id = every provider who charged a visit code that day; data_card 5.2). With all the count reads rpt_visits (distinct patients); with a list it reads rpt_provider_visits, so a patient seen by two selected providers on one day counts once per provider row but once in the distinct total. Legacy role (transaction provider) is inferred - confirm on the live tool.

patients_list_reports.r06.s05.c01.notes: Provider role on this report (report_by = attached_to_provider and the other modes that keep the PROVIDER section): scope.provider_attribution = attached (NEW role, owner 04 section 3 and 03 section 5.2: coalesce(rpt_patient_dim.preferred_provider_id, rpt_patient_activity.last_visit_provider_id)); the fallback is labelled on history (coverage 78a: no provider is attached to migrated patients). In mode preferred_provider the same picker filters rpt_patient_dim.preferred_provider_id only (the group key of that mode). How Attached to Provider differs from mode Preferred Provider is not documented - confirm on the live tool. Hidden when report_by = last_visit (04 shared rule).

patients_list_reports.r06.s08.c01.notes: Specialty of the provider resolved as for provider_ids (attached provider; preferred provider in mode preferred_provider), not of a referral source. rpt_provider_dim.specialty is free text: codes of the specialties option source match it through a NEW rpt_value_map domain specialty (owner 03); blank on 96 of 97 migrated providers (availability provider_specialty_sparse). Legacy single-select; the parameter accepts a list (enhancement). Hidden when report_by = last_visit (04 shared rule). Confirm the list source on the live tool.

patients_list_reports.r07.s04.c01.notes: Shared preferred_provider_ids: preferred provider of the patient (rpt_patient_dim.preferred_provider_id, no fallback; migrated patients carry none and match only all). Interim: the group key is the same provider (band 'Provider : <name> : <ShortID>', patients without one under (No Preferred Provider)), per the research inference that PREFERRED PROVIDER is both filter and grouping key. The 2021 Ortho sample header may instead be the contract provider (rpt_payment_plan_contracts.provider_id), offered as the enhancement contract_provider_ids - confirm on the live tool. ALL = no restriction.

patients_list_reports.r03.s04.c01.notes: Primary date range; the basis follows report_by: appointment -> appointment_date of the new-patient appointment (rpt_appointment_facts); created_date_first_visit_date -> created date of the patient record and/or first_visit_date (rpt_patient_activity) - how the legacy screen chooses between the two is not documented; referral, referral_type -> date the record was created (vendor: new records in the range) - inferred; carrier -> not documented. Whether the section title changes with the mode was not captured. Default today in the office time zone.

patients_list_reports.r03.s04.c02.notes: Primary date range, inclusive end; basis follows report_by exactly as Start Date (appointment_date / created_date / first_visit_date). Default today in the office time zone.

patients_list_reports.r05.s04.c01.notes: Primary date range, fixed basis created date of the note (patient_notes created_at as office-local date; app-era notes only). Migrated account_notes have no note-date column and their created_at is the load time (created_at_reliable = false): they are outside the date predicate and print only with the enhancement include_undated_migrated_notes (Date Created '-'). Default today in the office time zone.

patients_list_reports.r05.s04.c02.notes: Primary date range, inclusive end, fixed basis created date of the note (app-era notes; migrated account_notes are undated and outside the predicate). Default today in the office time zone.

patients_list_reports.r09.s04.c01.notes: Primary date range, fixed basis created date of the guarantor account (rpt_account_dim.created_at_utc as office-local date). Applies in every report_by mode except send_statement_status. That it also applies in mode balance_aged_over_x_days rests on an older (2021) build screen; the current aged panel was never seen - inferred, confirm on the live tool. Migrated accounts carry the back-fill time: REPAIR(10). Default today in the office time zone.

patients_list_reports.r09.s04.c02.notes: Primary date range, inclusive end, fixed basis account created date; hidden when report_by = send_statement_status. Default today in the office time zone.

patients_list_reports.r09.s06.c01.notes: Inactive account = an account in which every member patient is inactive (rpt_account_dim.active_member_count = 0). false (legacy default, unticked) = such accounts are left out; true = they are listed too. Not the patient-level include_inactive_patients.

patients_list_reports.r10.s03.c01.notes: Lower bound, inclusive, on the current account balance of the canonical ledger layer (PD-2, PD-4: rpt_ar_open_items unit account). Population = accounts with rpt_account_dim.send_collections true. Inferred: 0.00 is a real bound, so credit-balance accounts are not listed by the default run (unlike the age range, no open-bound rule is documented) - confirm on the live tool.

patients_list_reports.r10.s03.c02.notes: Upper bound, inclusive, on the current account balance. Inferred: 999999.99 is the practical open bound. Confirm on the live tool.

patients_list_reports.r11.s04.c01.notes: Single date, role filter_equals: equality with patient_statements.statement_date of the stored statement rows; statement_type filters patient_statements.delivery_method. Default today in the office time zone.

patients_list_reports.r12.s03.c01.notes: Single date. Binding inferred: office-local date of NEW patient_statements.delivery_attempted_at (timestamp written by the e-statement handler, RPT-PLIST-55 / DATA-22 / RPT-STMT-23) on rows with delivery_method email and the NEW delivery_status 'failed'; delivered_at is a date and is set only on success. The vendor says e-statements are sent three days after the statement date, so the date is not the statement date. Confirm on the live tool. Default today in the office time zone.

patients_list_reports.r11.s01.c01.notes: Delivery channel: paper = patient_statements.delivery_method print, or NULL with delivery_status generated (generated, not yet marked) - inferred; email = delivery_method email and not failed; both = no channel restriction (download rows appear only here). Whether downloaded portal statements count as Paper is not documented - confirm. Email and Both are greyed in the only capture; 04 9.4 keeps them enabled (option_enabled_when unknown) until read on the live tool - candidate rule: the organisation e-statement feature. Default paper as captured.

patients_list_reports.r06.x01.notes: 04 shared vendor-doc parameter provider_basis with a per-report option list: option treating_provider is NEW (04 section 3 to add; the Aging reports list preferred_provider / transaction_provider). preferred_provider -> the picker and the group key read rpt_patient_dim.preferred_provider_id (no fallback; patients without one under (No Preferred Provider)); treating_provider -> both read the provider of the last visit (rpt_patient_activity.last_visit_provider_id). Visible only when report_by = last_visit. Legacy preselection is not documented by the vendor screenshots; 04 sets preferred_provider (first option) - confirm on the live tool.

patients_list_reports.r06.x02.notes: PREFERRED PROVIDER picker of mode Last Visit. Shared preferred_provider_ids (lookup:providers, all = no restriction; legacy pickers default to Include All, vendor article on the new reports). Its provider_role is switched by provider_basis on this report (preferred -> preferred provider; treating_provider -> last-visit provider): an extension of the shared definition that 04 must record. Not provider_ids, which 04 hides in this mode. Visible only when report_by = last_visit. Row label and default were not quoted by the vendor screenshots - confirm on the live tool.

patients_list_reports.r06.x03.notes: 04 shared vendor-doc parameter last_visit_date (value keys last_visit_date_from, last_visit_date_to, last_visit_date_preset): attribute range on the general last visit of the patient (rpt_patient_activity.last_visit_date, last visit-code charge; REPAIR(19) until patients.last_visit is maintained), inclusive, office-local dates; not the ortho last visit. Visible only when report_by = last_visit. Default today / today (date_preset today) per the cross-cutting legacy rule 'every date box defaults to the current day' (research 3.1) and the Provider Holidays capture of the same header - inferred, confirm on the live tool. Enhanced with presets and relative tokens.
patients_list_reports.r06.x03.default_differs_reason: The vendor capture of mode Last Visit shows the box empty; research section 3.1 states every date box of the Lists screens defaults to the current day. Interim today / today until the live tool shows otherwise.

patients_list_reports.r06.x04.notes: 04 shared vendor-doc parameter include_patients_with_no_last_visit: true = patients whose last_visit_date is NULL are added to the rows selected by last_visit_date; false = they are left out. Visible only when report_by = last_visit. Legacy default not documented: false (unticked, also the disabled value) is inferred from the research (reactivation users tick the box) - confirm on the live tool.

patients_list_reports.r09.x01.notes: 04 shared vendor-doc parameter send_statement_status: yes = accounts flagged to receive statements (rpt_account_dim.send_statements true), no = accounts not flagged (documented use: list before a statement run the accounts that will get no statement). Visible and required only when report_by = send_statement_status, where it replaces the created date range. Default yes (first option) - INFERRED, confirm on the live tool.
patients_list_reports.r09.x01.default_differs_reason: A legacy dropdown always shows one value; the default is not documented. yes (first option) is preselected - INFERRED, confirm on the live tool.

patients_list_reports.r01.s04.c01.notes: Primary date range. Fixed basis appointment_date (rpt_appointment_facts.appointment_date, office-local); this section has no basis radio. Default = today in the office time zone (relative token). Enhanced with presets and relative tokens.

patients_list_reports.r01.s04.c02.notes: Primary date range, inclusive end. Fixed basis appointment_date; no basis radio. Default = today in the office time zone (relative token). Enhanced with presets and relative tokens.
